name: Actroid
summary: A line of realistic female-appearance androids developed by Kokoro with Hiroshi Ishiguro's group and first shown at the 2005 Aichi Expo. Silicone skin, pneumatic actuation and idle micro-motions (blinking, breathing) give a lifelike seated presence; Actroids are leased as receptionists, exhibition guides and research subjects.
notable: One of the first commercially available realistic androids
Basis for Ishiguro's Repliee and Geminoid research
